review.visual: Inspected source. One closed rectangular shallow box; warm cocoa painterly texture, gold botanical ornament, original toad crest and green ribbon. No baked text, logos, scene or UI. Clean legible main silhouette.
limitations: Source output is 1254 square rather than requested 1024.
Main subject occupies approximately 91% of source width rather than requested 80%; renderer needs inset framing.
Very-low-alpha pixels extend beyond the visible body, so do not use alpha>0 bounding box as automatic crop.
Closed image is a single flattened raster; lid/base/interior continuity requires separately generated matching pieces.
